sent_bad: Based on `doc.txt`, here is what the document says about VBAC:
The main risk is uterine rupture: "Because a C-section leaves a scar on your uterus, the pressure of labor could cause your uterus to open (rupture) along your C-section scar."

Since your doctor has already told you it's an option, the document's guidance is to review these factors with your provider, confirm your incision type from your medical records, and plan your delivery together.
